results.title: Pay to open a folder with test money: a drive sells a folder of three; a phone with no drive pays; Waiting → Unlocked; three names, one opens; a reload keeps its opens; a second stranger gets 402
notes: ok: Make pay link: a /p/ link with half of the key after the #, and a code to scan (<link>)
ok: the payment checker opened the drive's sealed sales key: the seller is ready
ok: the pay page's data never carries the seller's address
ok: the page knows a folder of three (folder, 3)
ok: the phone: the folder's name, three files, about how big, the price and the fee (3 files, about 1 MB)
ok: the names inside stay locked; no address before a claim
ok: Pay with test money: Waiting → Seen → On the chain → Unlocked (['wait:done', 'seen:done', 'chain:done', 'open:done'])
ok: the folder lists its names (['agenda.txt', 'budget.txt', 'minutes.txt'])
ok: minutes.txt opens on the phone in the preview, as text, with Download (text)
ok: a reload keeps the claim (2 opens left until Oct 26.)
ok: the page links the test money's transaction
ok: What the chain sees: the transaction, with its fee (public)
ok: every output amount is hidden (['hidden', 'hidden'])
ok: no name and not the link's half of the key in any request (E-03)
ok: a stranger with the same link and no payment: 402 payment_required (402)
ok: a second stranger sees the price and no files
ok: the seller's folder wears its price (Pay 0.1 tTARI)
